/**
 * In-window glass bottom sheet (same window as the content, so the backdrop blur works):
 * scrim, drag handle, drag-down or back to dismiss.
 */
@Composable
fun GlassSheet(
    visible: Boolean,
    onDismiss: () -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    title: String? = null,
    scrollable: Boolean = true,
    content: @Composable ColumnScope.() -> Unit,
) {
    val c = Retra.colors
    val reduce = Retra.reduceMotion
    BackHandler(enabled = visible, onBack = onDismiss)
    Box(modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
        AnimatedVisibility(visible, enter = fadeIn(tween(180)), exit = fadeOut(tween(180))) {
            Box(
                Modifier
                    .fillMaxSize()
                    .background(c.scrim)
                    .clickable(interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() }, indication = null, onClickLabel = "Close", onClick = onDismiss),
            )
        }
        AnimatedVisibility(
            visible,
            modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.BottomCenter),
            enter = if (reduce) fadeIn() else slideInVertically(spring(Motion.DAMPING, Motion.SMOOTH)) { it } + fadeIn(tween(120)),
            exit = if (reduce) fadeOut() else slideOutVertically(spring(1f, Motion.SMOOTH)) { it } + fadeOut(tween(200, 80)),
        ) {
            val offset = remember { Animatable(0f) }
            val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
            val density = LocalDensity.current
            val maxH = LocalConfiguration.current.screenHeightDp.dp * 0.88f
            val shape = RoundedCornerShape(topStart = Radius.large, topEnd = Radius.large)
            GlassSurface(
                Modifier
                    .widthIn(max = 640.dp)
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .heightIn(max = maxH)
                    .graphicsLayer { translationY = offset.value }
                    .semantics { if (title != null) paneTitle = title },
                shape = shape,
                elevation = Elevation.overlay,
                blur = true,
                strong = true,
            ) {
                Column(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().windowInsetsPadding(WindowInsets.safeDrawing.only(WindowInsetsSides.Bottom + WindowInsetsSides.Horizontal))) {
                    // Drag handle area.
                    Box(
                        Modifier
                            .fillMaxWidth()
                            .height(28.dp)
                            .draggable(
                                orientation = Orientation.Vertical,
                                state = rememberDraggableState { d -> scope.launch { offset.snapTo((offset.value + d).coerceAtLeast(0f)) } },
                                onDragStopped = { v ->
                                    if (offset.value > with(density) { 120.dp.toPx() } || v > 1800f) onDismiss()
                                    else offset.animateTo(0f, spring(Motion.DAMPING, Motion.SMOOTH))
                                },
                            ),
                        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
                    ) {
                        Box(Modifier.size(width = 40.dp, height = 5.dp).clip(Radius.pillShape).background(c.inkMuted.copy(alpha = 0.35f)))
                    }
                    if (title != null) {
                        Text(title, style = RetraType.title, color = c.ink, modifier = Modifier.padding(start = Space.l, end = Space.l, bottom = Space.s))
                    }
                    Column(
                        Modifier
                            .fillMaxWidth()
                            .then(if (scrollable) Modifier.verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()) else Modifier)
                            .padding(start = Space.l, end = Space.l, bottom = Space.l),
                        content = content,
                    )
                }
            }
            LaunchedEffect(Unit) { offset.snapTo(0f) }
        }
    }
}

/** Glass toast host; shows app messages at the top, one at a time. */
@Composable
fun BoxScope.ToastHost(message: AppMessage?, onDone: () -> Unit) {
    val c = Retra.colors
    var current by remember { mutableStateOf<AppMessage?>(null) }
    LaunchedEffect(message) {
        if (message != null) {
            current = message
            delay(2800)
            current = null
            delay(250)
            onDone()
        }
    }
    AnimatedVisibility(
        current != null,
        modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.TopCenter).windowInsetsPadding(WindowInsets.safeDrawing.only(WindowInsetsSides.Top)).padding(top = Space.xs),
        enter = slideInVertically(spring(Motion.DAMPING, Motion.SMOOTH)) { -it } + fadeIn(),
        exit = slideOutVertically { -it } + fadeOut(),
    ) {
        val m = current ?: message ?: return@AnimatedVisibility
        GlassSurface(
            Modifier.padding(horizontal = Space.m).widthIn(max = 520.dp).semantics { liveRegion = LiveRegionMode.Polite; contentDescription = m.text },
            shape = Radius.pillShape,
            elevation = Elevation.floating,
            blur = true,
            strong = true,
        ) {
            androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Row(Modifier.padding(horizontal = Space.m, vertical = Space.s), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                val (icon, tint) = when (m.tone) {
                    MessageTone.SUCCESS -> Icons.Rounded.CheckCircle to c.success
                    MessageTone.ERROR -> Icons.Rounded.ErrorOutline to c.danger
                    MessageTone.INFO -> Icons.Rounded.Info to c.accent
                }
                Icon(icon, null, tint = tint, modifier = Modifier.size(20.dp))
                androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Spacer(Modifier.width(Space.xs))
                Text(m.text, style = RetraType.label, color = c.ink)
            }
        }
    }
}

/** Thin pill progress bar (downloads). */
@Composable
fun ProgressPill(progress: Float, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
    val c = Retra.colors
    val p by animateFloatAsState(progress.coerceIn(0f, 1f), Motion.smooth(Retra.reduceMotion), label = "progress")
    Box(
        modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .height(10.dp)
            .clip(Radius.pillShape)
            .background(c.inkFaint)
            .semantics { progressBarRangeInfo = ProgressBarRangeInfo(progress, 0f..1f) },
    ) {
        Box(
            Modifier
                .fillMaxHeight()
                .fillMaxWidth(p)
                .clip(Radius.pillShape)
                .background(Brush.horizontalGradient(listOf(c.accent.copy(alpha = 0.7f), c.accent))),
        )
    }
}

/**
 * The patching moment: a ring fills around Mochi (bouncing while working, happy when done).
 */
@Composable
fun PatchProgressRing(progress: Float, done: Boolean, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, size: Dp = 168.dp) {
    val c = Retra.colors
    val p by animateFloatAsState(if (done) 1f else progress.coerceIn(0f, 1f), Motion.smooth(Retra.reduceMotion), label = "ring")
    Column(modifier, horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally) {
        Box(Modifier.size(size).semantics { progressBarRangeInfo = ProgressBarRangeInfo(p, 0f..1f) }, contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
            Canvas(Modifier.size(size)) {
                val stroke = 12.dp.toPx()
                val inset = stroke / 2
                drawArc(c.inkFaint, 0f, 360f, false, topLeft = Offset(inset, inset), size = Size(this.size.width - stroke, this.size.height - stroke), style = Stroke(stroke))
                drawArc(
                    Brush.sweepGradient(listOf(c.accent.copy(alpha = 0.55f), c.accent, c.accent.copy(alpha = 0.55f))),
                    -90f, 360f * p, false,
                    topLeft = Offset(inset, inset), size = Size(this.size.width - stroke, this.size.height - stroke),
                    style = Stroke(stroke, cap = StrokeCap.Round),
                )
            }
            Mochi(mood = if (done) MochiMood.HAPPY else MochiMood.LOADING, size = size * 0.58f)
        }
        Spacer(Modifier.height(12.dp))
        Text(if (done) "Ready to play!" else "${(p * 100).toInt()} %", style = RetraType.headline, color = c.ink)
    }
}

private data class Page(val title: String, val body: String, val mood: MochiMood, val badge: ImageVector)

private val pages = listOf(
    Page("Hi, I'm Mochi!", "Retra plays Game Boy Advance games: the ones you own, free homebrew, and Pokémon fan games.", MochiMood.HAPPY, Icons.Rounded.Favorite),
    Page("Fan games, made easy", "Pick a fan game, add your own cartridge dump, and Retra patches it for you. We never hand out commercial games.", MochiMood.SURPRISED, Icons.Rounded.AutoFixHigh),
    Page("Your progress is safe", "Retra saves as you play, keeps backups of your saves, and remembers your spot so you can continue in one tap.", MochiMood.SLEEPY, Icons.Rounded.Save),
)

@Composable
fun OnboardingScreen(
    onFinish: () -> Unit,
    onImport: () -> Unit,
    onExplore: () -> Unit,
    initialPage: Int = 0,
) {
    val c = Retra.colors
    val pager = rememberPagerState(initialPage) { pages.size }
    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
    Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
        AmbientSky()
        Column(
            Modifier.fillMaxSize().windowInsetsPadding(WindowInsets.safeDrawing).padding(horizontal = Space.gutter, vertical = Space.m),
            horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
        ) {
            Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                LogoTile(size = 40.dp)
                Spacer(Modifier.width(10.dp))
                Text("Retra", style = RetraType.title, color = c.ink, modifier = Modifier.weight(1f))
                if (pager.currentPage < pages.lastIndex) RetraButton("Skip", onFinish, style = ButtonStyle.TERTIARY, compact = true)
            }
            HorizontalPager(pager, Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth()) { i ->
                val p = pages[i]
                Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally, verticalArrangement = Arrangement.Center) {
                    Box(contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                        GlassSurface(Modifier.size(232.dp), shape = Radius.pillShape) {}
                        Mochi(mood = p.mood, size = 176.dp, description = "Mochi")
                        GlassSurface(Modifier.align(Alignment.BottomEnd).size(56.dp), shape = Radius.pillShape, wash = c.accentSoft) {
                            Icon(p.badge, null, tint = c.onAccentSoft, modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.Center).size(26.dp))
                        }
                    }
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(Space.xl))
                    Text(p.title, style = RetraType.display, color = c.ink, textAlign = TextAlign.Center)
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(Space.s))
                    Text(p.body, style = RetraType.body, color = c.inkMuted, textAlign = TextAlign.Center, modifier = Modifier.widthIn(max = 340.dp))
                }
            }
            Dots(pager.currentPage, pages.size)
            Spacer(Modifier.height(Space.l))
            Column(Modifier.widthIn(max = 420.dp).fillMaxWidth()) {
                if (pager.currentPage == pages.lastIndex) {
                    RetraButton("Import your games", { onFinish(); onImport() }, Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), icon = Icons.Rounded.AddCircle)
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(Space.xs))
                    RetraButton("Explore the library", { onFinish(); onExplore() }, Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), icon = Icons.Rounded.Storefront, style = ButtonStyle.SECONDARY)
                } else {
                    RetraButton("Next", { scope.launch { pager.animateScrollToPage(pager.currentPage + 1) } }, Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), icon = Icons.AutoMirrored.Rounded.ArrowForward)
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(Space.xs))
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(52.dp))
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun Dots(current: Int, count: Int) {
    val c = Retra.colors
    Row(Modifier.semantics { contentDescription = "Page ${current + 1} of $count" }, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
        repeat(count) { i ->
            val w by animateDpAsState(if (i == current) 28.dp else 8.dp, Motion.smooth(Retra.reduceMotion), label = "dot")
            Box(Modifier.height(8.dp).width(w).clip(Radius.pillShape).background(if (i == current) c.accent else c.inkMuted.copy(alpha = 0.3f)))
        }
    }
}

            if cmd in 'MLQC':

#!/bin/sh
# Retra engine test runner: builds retra-headless and runs every available test ROM.
#
#   engine/host/run_tests.sh            (downloads freely-licensed test ROMs into $ROMS)
#
# Environment:
#   ROMS=/tmp/retra-test-roms   where test ROMs are downloaded/unpacked (never the repo)
#   BUILD=/tmp/retra-host-build host build directory
#   NO_DOWNLOAD=1               only use ROMs already present
#
# Exit status is non-zero if any check fails. Missing ROMs are reported as SKIP.
set -u
HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
ENGINE="$(cd "$HERE/.." && pwd)"
REPO="$(cd "$ENGINE/.." && pwd)"
ROMS=${ROMS:-/tmp/retra-test-roms}
BUILD=${BUILD:-/tmp/retra-host-build}
PY="python3 -I"
PASS=0
FAIL=0
SKIP=0

pass() { PASS=$((PASS + 1)); printf '  PASS  %s\n' "$1"; }
fail() { FAIL=$((FAIL + 1)); printf '  FAIL  %s %s\n' "$1" "${2:-}"; }
skip() { SKIP=$((SKIP + 1)); printf '  SKIP  %s %s\n' "$1" "${2:-}"; }

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ build
echo "== building retra-headless ($BUILD)"
mkdir -p "$BUILD"
if command -v ninja >/dev/null 2>&1; then GEN="-G Ninja"; else GEN=""; fi
( cd "$BUILD" && cmake $GEN "$HERE" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release >/dev/null && cmake --build . -j 2 >/dev/null ) || {
    echo "build failed"; exit 1; }
BIN="$BUILD/retra-headless"

echo "== unit tests (cheats, battery saves, save states, ROM info)"
if "$BUILD/retra-unit-tests" > "$BUILD/unit.log" 2>&1; then pass "unit tests"; else fail "unit tests"; cat "$BUILD/unit.log"; fi

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ fetch test ROMs
mkdir -p "$ROMS"
fetch() {  # fetch URL DEST_DIR (zip archives are unpacked into DEST_DIR)
    url=$1; dest=$2
    [ -d "$dest" ] && return 0
    [ "${NO_DOWNLOAD:-0}" = "1" ] && return 1
    tmp="$ROMS/.dl.$$"
    if curl -sfL --max-time 120 -o "$tmp" "$url"; then
        mkdir -p "$dest"
        case "$url" in
            *.zip|*/master.zip) (cd "$dest" && unzip -q -o "$tmp") ;;
            *) mv "$tmp" "$dest/$(basename "$url")" ;;
        esac
        rm -f "$tmp"
        return 0
    fi
    rm -f "$tmp"
    return 1
}
echo "== test ROMs ($ROMS)"
fetch https://github.com/jsmolka/gba-tests/archive/refs/heads/master.zip "$ROMS/jsmolka" || true
fetch https://github.com/destoer/armwrestler-gba-fixed/archive/refs/heads/master.zip "$ROMS/armwrestler" || true
fetch https://s3.amazonaws.com/mgba/suite-latest.zip "$ROMS/mgba-suite" || true
#!/bin/sh
# Rebuilds Mochi Hop deterministically: assets -> C -> ROM.
set -e
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
CC=${CC:-arm-none-eabi-gcc}
OBJCOPY=${OBJCOPY:-arm-none-eabi-objcopy}
PY=${PYTHON:-python3}
OUT=build
mkdir -p $OUT/gen $OUT/obj

echo "[1/4] generating assets"
$PY tools/gen_assets.py $OUT/gen

CFLAGS="-mcpu=arm7tdmi -mtune=arm7tdmi -mthumb -mthumb-interwork -O2 -Wall -Wno-char-subscripts \
 -ffreestanding -fno-strict-aliasing -fomit-frame-pointer -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections \
 -Isrc -I$OUT/gen $EXTRA_CFLAGS -ffile-prefix-map=$(pwd)=."

echo "[2/4] compiling"
$CC $CFLAGS -c src/crt0.S -o $OUT/obj/crt0.o
for f in main play gfx audio save; do
  $CC $CFLAGS -c src/$f.c -o $OUT/obj/$f.o
done
$CC $CFLAGS -O1 -c $OUT/gen/assets.c -o $OUT/obj/assets.o

echo "[3/4] linking"
$CC -mcpu=arm7tdmi -mthumb -mthumb-interwork -nostartfiles -nostdlib -T gba.ld \
  -Wl,--no-warn-rwx-segments -Wl,-Map,$OUT/mochi_hop.map \
  $OUT/obj/crt0.o $OUT/obj/main.o $OUT/obj/play.o $OUT/obj/gfx.o $OUT/obj/audio.o $OUT/obj/save.o \
  $OUT/obj/assets.o -lgcc -o $OUT/mochi_hop.elf
$OBJCOPY -O binary $OUT/mochi_hop.elf $OUT/mochi_hop.gba

name: Build Retra

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths-ignore: ["**/*.md", "docs/**"]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: retra-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  engine:
    name: Engine (host tests)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Install toolchain
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y cmake ninja-build gcc-arm-none-eabi libnewlib-arm-none-eabi
      - name: Run engine test suite
        run: sh engine/host/run_tests.sh
      - name: Check Mochi Hop builds reproducibly
        run: |
          sh game/build.sh
          cmp game/build/mochi_hop.gba app/src/main/assets/games/mochi_hop.gba

  android:
    name: Android (tests + APKs)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: "21"
      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
      - uses: android-actions/setup-android@v3
      - name: Install SDK packages
        run: |
          yes | sdkmanager --licenses > /dev/null || true
          sdkmanager "platforms;android-37.0" "build-tools;37.0.0" "ndk;28.2.13676358" "cmake;3.22.1"
      - name: Unit tests
        run: ./gradlew --stacktrace :patcher:test :app:testDebugUnitTest
      - name: Assemble APKs
        run: ./gradlew --stacktrace :app:assembleDebug :app:assembleRelease
      - name: Collect APKs
        run: |
          mkdir -p out
          cp app/build/outputs/apk/debug/*.apk out/Retra-${GITHUB_SHA::8}-debug.apk
          cp app/build/outputs/apk/release/*.apk out/Retra-${GITHUB_SHA::8}-release.apk
          sha256sum out/*.apk | tee out/SHA256SUMS.txt
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: Retra-apks
          path: out/
          if-no-files-found: error
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: failure()
        with:
          name: test-reports
          path: "**/build/reports/tests/"
          if-no-files-found: ignore

# Retra app — design direction and tokens

```
Direction: Playful-soft "cute 2D under liquid glass" for GBA players (Pokémon fans first), optimized for getting back into a game in one tap.
Type: Fredoka (display, rounded) / Nunito (body). Palette: tinted neutrals ("cloud cream" light, "night indigo" dark) + Mochi pink accent (+ success / warning / danger).
Signature: Mochi, the squishy rice-cake mascot, living on a pastel sky, with glossy glass surfaces (specular top rim) and a floating glass dock whose indicator stretches like a liquid drop between tabs.
Density: balanced (airy on Home, denser in My Games / Settings).  Motion: subtle springs, one orchestrated moment per screen (staggered entrance), squish on press.
```

## Atmosphere
A calm, pastel sky that drifts very slowly behind everything (three soft light pools, 40 s loop, static
with reduced motion). Content sits on glass: translucent fill, a top-lit sheen, a 1 dp specular rim that
fades from bright at the top to nearly nothing at the bottom, and a soft shadow tinted toward the
background hue. Real backdrop blur (Haze) is only used where content actually scrolls under a surface
(dock, sticky headers, sheets, player menu) — blurring a smooth gradient is invisible, so cards are
cheap translucent glass. Below API 31 blur degrades to a denser frosted tint.

Mochi carries the emotion: happy on Home, sleepy in empty states, surprised on errors, bouncing while
loading. Everything else stays quiet so Mochi and the game art can be the colour.

## Tokens (code: `app/src/main/kotlin/app/retra/ui/theme/Tokens.kt`)

### Colour — semantic layer (light / dark)
| Token | Light "cloud cream" | Dark "night indigo" | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sky` | `#FBF5F1` | `#15132B` | window background base |
| `skyGlowA/B/C` | `#FFD3E1` / `#FFE6C7` / `#D7E4FF` | `#3B2C66` / `#2A3A6E` / `#4A2A55` | ambient light pools |
| `glassFill` | white 62 % | `#2C2950` 62 % | glass surface tint |
| `glassFillStrong` | white 86 % | `#2C2950` 90 % | frosted fallback / sheets |
| `glassRim` | white 95 % → 10 % | white 32 % → 4 % | specular rim gradient |
| `ink` | `#2B2130` | `#F4EFFB` | primary text (14.3 : 1 / 16.0 : 1) |
| `inkMuted` | `#6B5E70` | `#B9B0CE` | secondary text (5.6 : 1 / 8.8 : 1) |
| `accent` | `#C7366B` | `#FF8FB4` | Mochi pink: primary actions, active states |
| `onAccent` | `#FFFFFF` (5.0 : 1) | `#2A0E1D` (8.4 : 1) | text on accent |
| `accentSoft` | `#FFE1EA` | `#4A2846` | selected chips, soft containers |
| `success` | `#23794F` | `#7FE0AE` | "You have it", verified |
| `warning` | `#965C0A` | `#F6C56E` | CRC mismatch, beta |
| `danger` | `#C4364A` | `#FF8F9C` | delete, errors |
| `shadow` | `#7A4A60` @ 14 % | black @ 40 % | tinted elevation |
